kurz: Raclette is melted cheese on potatoes. It turns creamy when it is just melting, and greasy when it gets too hot.
bild_im_kopf: Like chocolate in your hand: a little warmth makes it soft, too much makes it run apart.

schluesselmomente.warum: The skin protects: the potato does not soak up water and stays floury but firm.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Heat the cheese only until it bubbles
schluesselmomente.warum: First the fat melts, then the protein softens. Heated too long, the proteins contract and squeeze out fat.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Eat with pickled gherkins and silverskin onions
schluesselmomente.warum: Acid counters the feeling of heaviness and makes every bite fresh again.
